title: PKE graph query template
description: definitions/queries/<id>.yaml: parameterised, read-only Cypher expanding from a seed entity (ADR-007 §7). Rows: id, kind, type, label, detail, depth.

keywords.description: Question words that select the template

seedTypes.description: Entity types the template expands from; * = any

default.description: Also run for a seed of these types when no keyword matches
